summary_1line: Kubera meets the Pandavas after Bhima’s slaughter of Yakshas, explains Agastya’s curse, absolves Bhima, and instructs Yudhishthira on patience, timing, and restraint.

image_candidates.scene_text: Kubera sits upon the radiant Pushpaka seat surrounded by Yakshas, Rakshasas, Gandharvas, and Apsaras while the Pandavas stand with folded hands before him.
The sage Agastya performs fierce austerities by the Yamuna with arms raised to the sun as the reckless Rakshasa Maniman insults him, provoking a blazing curse.
Bhima, wounded yet unbowed, stands gripping his bow and gazing boldly at Kubera amid ranks of strange Yakshas with massive bodies and peg-like ears.
